_: Kill-check for the nine per-type closures in packages/adapter-claude-code/src/derive.ts, written when they were extracted into their own functions. Each mutant breaks ONE rule a closure encodes and names the single test that must notice. The killers were found empirically rather than guessed -- each mutant was applied, derive.test.ts was run with vitest's JSON reporter, and the failing test names were read off -- because a killer that only *should* fail is the same false green as an assertion that is never shown to fail. There is NO intended survivor here, and that is the honest result rather than an omission: all eight mutants are observable, so declaring one equivalent to exercise the `held` path would have meant inventing one. That path is exercised by scripts/mutations/types-capture.json and statement-count.json.
